name: OpenSSL in container base image below 3.0.13
description: Container OS-level OpenSSL before 3.0.13 is subject to multiple CVEs including x509 name constraint handling issues.
rationale: Base-image cryptographic libraries affect every workload running on the image. NIST SC-17 covers public key infrastructure certificates; SC-12 covers key establishment. PCI DSS 4.2.2 requires trusted certificate chains.
